errors.text_span: Върху тази ос също е показан общият брой регистрирани автомобили в България – 3 007 920
errors.evidence: The left vertical axis has a range from 0 to 70,000. The value 3,007,920 is not shown on this axis. This value appears in the legend at the bottom of the chart.
The legend does not associate the blue color with the label "броя на автомобилите" (number of cars). Instead, the legend shows the blue color swatch next to the number "3 007 920".
